worcester.definition:
n. United States lexicographer who was accused of plagiarism by Noah Webster (1784-1865)
n. an industrial and university city in central Massachusetts to the west of Boston
n. a cathedral city in west central England on the River Severn
worcester.translation: 伍斯特(①姓氏 ②英国城市 ③美国城市)

worcester sauce.translation: n. 伍斯特沙司；伍斯特郡辣酱油

worcestershire.definition: n a savory sauce of vinegar and soy sauce and spices
worcestershire.translation: 伍斯特郡[英国英格兰原郡名]

worcestershire sauce.translation: 辣酱油；伍斯特沙司（英国伍斯特市产的沙司, 用葱、蒜、香料、胡椒等熬煮加糖、盐、白醋等制成）
